_doc: Tel'aran'rhiod. In the World of Dreams what you imagine is, if your will holds: these are the things a dreamer can do there, eight of them at a time on the dream bar (tune.bar, in the slots keyed by tune.bar_keys, QWERTY positions; a character keeps its own as profile.dream_bar and profile.dream_slot_keys, chosen in the dream inventory, I). Every one spends Will (the mind's stamina: tune.will, coming back at tune.regen a second once you have done nothing dreamlike for tune.rest seconds, faster standing still). kind shift: you are simply somewhere else (where = behind the one you look at | back | aim). kind bolt: a thing imagined and thrown. kind chain: binds the one you look at after `wind` seconds unless they are gone from the spot or Deny it. kind pit: the ground under the aim point turns on those standing there. kind wall: a wall across your front that stops what flies. kind deny: for `window` seconds whatever dream-thing reaches you is unmade, and the one who made it is shaken (tune.shaken seconds without the dream, and tune.rebuke Will lost). Only activities with dream: true allow any of it. Parameters beyond the first eight: a bolt may have count and spread (several at once), home (turns toward the nearest foe, radians a second), knock (knocked down that long), hit (how close it must pass). A chain may hold (secs), cage (no stepping away while held), drain (Will taken) or shove (thrown that many paces away from you; negative draws them in, short of your feet). A pit may have burst (struck once when it opens, then gone) and slow 1.0 (no mire). A wall may be a ring round you (radius) or reflect (what is thrown at it goes back). kind mend heals you; kind fade: untouchable and unable to strike for secs; kind haste: quicker on your feet for secs (mult); shift where side: six paces to the side you look toward; where swap: you and the one you look at change places.

shift_behind.name: Step behind
shift_behind.blurb: You are behind the one you are looking at.

shift_back.name: Step away
shift_back.blurb: You are seven paces back from where you stood.

shift_aim.name: Step there
shift_aim.blurb: You are where you were looking.

deny.name: Deny
deny.blurb: It is not so. What reaches you in the next instant is unmade.

dream_chains.name: Chains
dream_chains.blurb: They hold the one you look at, unless they are gone first.

dream_pit.name: The ground turns
dream_pit.blurb: Where you look, the earth takes hold of whoever stands on it.

dream_wall.name: A wall
dream_wall.blurb: Stone across your front: nothing thrown comes through.

shift_side.name: Step aside
shift_side.blurb: Six paces to whichever side you look toward.

shift_swap.name: Change places
shift_swap.blurb: You stand where they stood, and they where you did.

dream_arrows.name: A flight of arrows
dream_arrows.blurb: Five arrows from nowhere, fanned across your aim.

dream_boulder.name: A boulder
dream_boulder.blurb: Slow and heavy: it knocks down whoever it meets.

dream_ravens.name: Ravens
dream_ravens.blurb: Three dark birds that turn after the nearest foe.

dream_cage.name: A cage
dream_cage.blurb: Bars close round the one you look at: not even stepping away gets them out. Slow to close.

dream_forget.name: Forgetting
dream_forget.blurb: Their will runs out of them like water: Will lost, unless they Deny it.

dream_shove.name: A great hand
dream_shove.blurb: The one you look at is thrown seven paces away from you.

dream_pull.name: Drawn in
dream_pull.blurb: The one you look at is dragged to your feet.

dream_fire.name: The ground burns
dream_fire.blurb: Fire out of bare earth where you look.

dream_storm.name: Lightning from a clear sky
dream_storm.blurb: A strike where you look, a breath later: be gone from under it.

dream_ring.name: A ring of stone
dream_ring.blurb: Walls on every side of you.

dream_mirror.name: A mirror
dream_mirror.blurb: What is thrown at it goes back the way it came.

dream_fade.name: Not quite here
dream_fade.blurb: Nothing touches you for a moment, and you touch nothing.

dream_haste.name: Quick as thought
dream_haste.blurb: Your feet carry you as fast as you think.
